# Get comments for each task assigned to me that is incomplete
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ0b2RvaXN0K2pvLWhhcnJAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.10J_XA_-nawL8ii_3Nht9YhqycPY9daeZeARxwZdpeg'
task_ids = [1357, 1386, 2672, 2674, 2678, 2682, 2683, 2694]
for tid in task_ids:
    print(f"Task {tid}:")
    # Fetch all comments (paginate)
    page = 0
    while True:
        resp = apis.todoist.show_task_comments(task_id=tid, access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        # resp is a list of comments
        if not resp:
            break
        for c in resp:
            print(c)
        if len(resp) < 20:
            break
        page += 1
    print("---")

instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thank you <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.
